lines.en: The chain turns and I lower slowly.
Plank by plank, I span the gap.
I slide forward along the stone channel.

lines.zh: 绞盘在拉我，我一点点升。
lines.en: The winch hauls me up inch by inch.
My planks strike each other, thudding.

lines.zh: 我横过护城河，稳稳落定。
lines.en: I cross the moat and settle firm.
The chain tautens with a clack.

lines.zh: 我身上还留着昨天雨的水。
lines.en: Last night's rain still beads on my planks.
I reach out from the gatehouse.

lines.zh: 我把这一侧的轮子推过去。
lines.en: I roll the near wheels across.
The joints in my timber creak.
Halfway out, I pause.

lines.zh: 我横在半空，铁链拉着我。
lines.en: I hang partway, held by the chain.
The nail heads on my planks are worn bright.
I wait for another turn of the winch.
Wind threads between my boards.
The moat is right below.
Upright, I'm a door.
A crow lands on my near end.
The chain sways slightly.
I've worn the stone channel smooth.
I hear someone shout behind me.
I settle my weight on the pivot.
Without the order, I don't move.
Moss is growing out of my seams.
Half of me is reflected in the water.
Crossing?

lines.zh: 我放下来的方向是那边。
lines.en: I come down toward that side.

lines.zh: 我的板子承得住人，不会塌。
lines.en: My planks will hold a person.
The chain rattles overhead.
Walk the middle; the edges are loose.
I know the keep's colours.
I'm not a road; I'm a gate.
Step back; I'm coming up.
It's deep below; watch your footing.
I reach three yards out from here.
Someone's walking on me.
My planks are old but unbroken.
Do you pay a toll to cross?
I'm waiting for the gatehouse signal.
This chain outlasts me.
If you don't dare, wait.
My shadow falls on the water.
A blow rings off my chain.
A plank has split.
My pin has worked loose.
The smell of the wood turns fresh.
I dropped two inches.
A scar is cut into the stone channel.
The chain never broke.
A plank splits; the chain still rings.
Someone's working the winch.
Two more turns and I'm set.
My pivot's dry and grinding.

lines.zh: 这块木板松了，给我一根新的。
lines.en: This plank's loose; bring a new one.

lines.zh: 你想让我放下，得先松链。
lines.en: Want me down? Release the chain.
I smell damp timber.
Pull once more and I'm across.
Something's pressing on my boards.
That seated me in the groove.
Pause the winch; let me settle.
You hit my planks and they thud.

lines.zh: 我纹丝没动，铁链也没动。
lines.en: I don't move, and neither does the chain.
You slipped — grab hold of me.
Don't push my end; it skews.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我把你顶回去了。
lines.en: That knock shoved you right back.
My chain swayed once.
Best get back on the bank.
Your heel's caught in my seam.
I'm far heavier than you.
I've risen a little.
Two bridges span the river together.

lines.zh: 铁链同一声响，木板同一下落。
lines.en: One clank, and both sets of planks drop.

lines.zh: 我们的板子在中间接上。
lines.en: Our planks meet in the middle.
Both gatehouses stand open.

lines.zh: 一队人马从两座桥上过。
lines.en: A column crosses on both.
At night we're hauled up.
We guard the same river.
Plank against plank.
We open again tomorrow.
Two shadows face each other in the water.
Something's wedged in my seam.
I'm resting on that rope.
A nail fell into the moat.
It's pressing on my middle span.
I'm holding it up; don't let it drop.
The plank will hold; set it down.
It slipped into the gap and vanished.
I've nudged it to the edge.
Too heavy — I creaked.
Someone's picked it up.
Something's moving across the water.
I start to come down.
The chain clacks along.
I need to lay this side flat.
They're charging.
I haven't reached the ground.
Plank by plank, I extend.
I'll take my place before the gate.
I stop half open.
There are shapes on the water.
I press my near end down.
Everyone's watching my planks.
I must be quick, but the winch is slow.
One more yard and I'm there.
The chain takes up its last link.
When I land, the sound is heavy.
I hold it down so nothing climbs up.
My planks shiver under its feet.
I rise a little and it slips a little.
The chain stays taut.

lines.zh: 我在等它能脱开的角度。
lines.en: I wait for the angle that shakes it off.
It's backing off; I speed up.
The seam has caught its foot.
I swing myself across.
The moat is all spray.

lines.zh: 我这一侧完全落下去了。
lines.en: My near side is fully down now.
It's stopped in the middle of me.
I settle into the channel and hold.
The chain rings like a watch bell.
It doesn't dare look down.
I mean to shake it off.
I'm waiting for the last inch.
The water is very close.
This move is a sheer drop.
Everyone waits for me to settle.
The last notch, and I hit bottom.
I come down and crush it.
The planks strike and it can't keep footing.

lines.zh: 我向上一抬，把它顶下去。
lines.en: I heave up and tip it over.
My chain swings and catches its leg.

lines.zh: 我的板子把它夹在中间。
lines.en: My boards close on it.
I rock, and it slides down.
That one landed solid.
It's in the moat.
I stop, no longer descending.
Spray splashes my planks.
It's hanging on my edge.
I raise, and it can't follow.
There's nothing under my planks.
It hit the stone channel.

lines.zh: 我这一下用上了全身重量。
lines.en: I put all my weight into that.
It can't make a sound under me.
I drop another notch.
The last sound is muffled.

lines.zh: 我从闸门里放下来，先响再落。
lines.en: I come out of the gatehouse, clanking before landing.
The chain takes the strain before the planks move.
I get halfway and hang.

lines.zh: 石槽上还留着旧的磨痕。
lines.en: Old wear marks line the stone channel.
The moat lies below.
The gate posts take my weight.

lines.zh: 我落定的时候，水面都震了。
lines.en: When I settle, the water shudders.
I know these walls.
The chain rings like a struck bell.
The wind swings me slightly.
My far end rests on the other bank.
Someone runs across me.
Water squeezes from my seams.
I'm waiting to be hauled in.
Someone's watching from the parapet.
I level myself out.
I knock against the stone lip.
This bank is a little low.
The fire starts at my planks' edge.

lines.zh: 我整座砸下去，铁链拉直了。
lines.en: I crash down and the chain snaps taut.

lines.zh: 水没过我的板面，我往下坠。
lines.en: Water covers my planks and I sink.
The blast rips a whole section of planks away.
An arrow sticks in my plank.
The chain tightens on its own.
The winch stalls and I'm stuck midair.

lines.zh: 雷顺着铁链走遍我全身。
lines.en: Lightning runs the chain the length of me.

lines.zh: 下面空了，我整座往下掉。
lines.en: Nothing below now; I fall whole.
